title: Anthropic commits to buy $30B of Microsoft Azure compute

sources.quote: Anthropic has committed to purchase $30 billion of Azure compute capacity and to contract additional compute capacity up to one gigawatt.

explain: Anthropic agreed to buy $30 billion of computing from Microsoft's Azure cloud, running on Nvidia chips. In the same deal Microsoft and Nvidia said they would invest up to $5 billion and $10 billion in Anthropic, so some money flows both ways.
